overview: A professional, mobile-responsive website for Washington's Perfect Print with a public site, admin-managed content, visa services, and appointment booking.
features: Browse printing services, promotions, and business advertising
Book appointments for printing services and consultations
Explore China, France, and USA visa assistance details
Admin panel to create, edit, and delete all content
View and manage client appointment bookings
Floating WhatsApp inquiry button on every page
Installable on a smartphone as a PWA
